Name: Jozabad, Chief of the Levites
Summary: Jozabad, a chief of the Levites, gave with Cononiah and the other chiefs five thousand small cattle and five hundred oxen for Josiah's Passover.
KeyStory: Hashabiah and Jeiel and Jozabad, chief of the Levites, gave unto the Levites for passover offerings.
RelatedPeople: Cononiah, Chief of the Levites; King Josiah
LifeLesson: Generosity among leaders fed a national feast.
